dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the lateral flank exhibit a high-contrast transition from dark-brown exterior pixels to light-tan perimeter pixels. Three prominent rings show jagged, non-uniform boundary widths enclosing dark interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid light-tan pixel clusters located in the interstices between major annuli. These blobs lack internal tonal gradients and are most concentrated near the posterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the lateral flank form a scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented longitudinally towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of interconnected annuli forming a complex chain-like topology across the dorsal mid-section.
